summary: Base 团队的 chunter-cb 把 EIP-8130 的交易类型拆成独立 EIP（后编号 EIP-8430），不依赖 Keystore，现有 secp256k1 EOA 即可使用，支持分阶段批量调用、gas 代付、二维 nonce 和带内 EIP-7702 式代码委托；EIP-8130 则只保留 Keystore。EIP-8141 合并一项修订，限制出块方重新执行未批准验证前缀的工作量，并改用 EIP-7976 计算 calldata 下限。forshtat 为 ERC-8421 替代内存池开讨论帖，称其与 MATCHA 思路相近。

items.topic: 原生 AA 的拆分与内存池
items.title: 新 EIP：AA 交易类型
items.note: （chunter-cb）。从 EIP-8130 拆出的 EIP-2718 交易类型，不依赖 Keystore，现有 EOA 用原生 secp256k1 认证即可使用：分阶段批量调用（调用可带原生 value）、有绑定和开放两种付款方模式的 gas 代付、二维 nonce（key 0 即账户 nonce）及无 nonce 模式、带内 EIP-7702 式代码委托。
items.note_en: (chunter-cb). An EIP-2718 transaction type split out of EIP-8130 with no Keystore dependency, usable by today's EOAs with native secp256k1 authentication: phased call batching (with native value in calls), gas sponsorship with bound and open payer modes, 2D nonces (key 0 is the account nonce) and a nonce-free mode, and in-band EIP-7702-style code delegation.

items.title: Magicians：ERC-8421 frame 交易替代内存池
items.note: 18:51（forshtat），结构与 ERC-4337 的 ERC-7562 验证规则相似并大体向后兼容，是比标准内存池更宽松的信誉系统；概念上与 MATCHA 相近，主要区别是计量单位（用掉的 gas 还是见到的交易数）。
items.title_en: Magicians: ERC-8421 frame transaction alternative mempools
items.note_en: 18:51 (forshtat), similar in structure to and mostly backward compatible with ERC-7562's validation rules for ERC-4337, a reputation-based system more permissive than the canonical mempool; conceptually close to MATCHA, with the main difference being the unit of accounting (gas used versus transactions seen).

items.title: EIP-8141：限制出块方对未批准验证前缀的重执行
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）合并。内存池部分已经限制了准入和链头变化后的重验证，但没有限制出块：frame 交易在某个帧批准之前不付任何费用。EIP-8141：用 7976 替换 7623（lightclient）合并；把 frame 过期验证器改为部署的标准合约。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: bound producer-side re-execution of an unapproving validation prefix
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil) was merged. The mempool section already bounds admission and head-change revalidation, but not block production: a frame transaction pays nothing until one of its frames approves. EIP-8141: replace 7623 with 7976 (lightclient) was merged; deploy the frames expiry verifier as a standard contract.

keywords_en: AA transaction type split out of EIP-8130
summary_en: chunter-cb of the Base team split EIP-8130's transaction type into its own EIP (later EIP-8430). It has no Keystore dependency and works for today's secp256k1 EOAs, supporting phased call batching, gas sponsorship, 2D nonces and in-band EIP-7702-style code delegation; EIP-8130 keeps only the Keystore. EIP-8141 merged a revision bounding how much work block producers spend re-executing unapproving validation prefixes, and switched to EIP-7976 for the calldata floor. forshtat opened a discussion thread for ERC-8421 alternative mempools, calling it conceptually close to MATCHA.
